Alice Blue Review (2026): Brokerage, Platforms, API & Execution - The Published Facts

Alice Blue is a Bengaluru-headquartered discount broker known for aggressive per-order pricing and a free API that plugs into several retail algo-trading platforms. It competes primarily on cost.

Frequently asked questions

What brokerage does Alice Blue charge?

Per its official pricing at our last review: delivery ₹20 or 2.5% per order (whichever is lower); ₹0 on the Freedom (F20) plan; intraday ₹15–₹20 per order depending on plan - see official pricing; F&O ₹15–₹20 per order depending on plan - see official pricing. Statutory charges apply on top. Verify the current schedule on the official pricing page, as rates change without notice.

Does Alice Blue offer a trading API?

Yes - ANT API. Published pricing: Free (per official page). See the official documentation for rate limits and terms.

How fast is Alice Blue's order execution?

Alice Blue publishes no execution-speed figure that we could verify on its official site or in top-ranked published comparisons, so this metric is shown as Not Disclosed.
